title: Bounded Borrowed No-DTD XML Validation
description: Incremental borrowed UTF8/XML1.0 syntax validation without DTD or DOM ownership. Fixed numeric ancestor/attribute spans, no source or tree clone. A work unit consumes one source byte with at most16 additional fixed-token lookups, or compares one pair of original name bytes. Emits borrowed root/attribute source spans; open source binding must remain immutable until close.
